question: What is the final instruction about refuge?
premises: One should abandon all dharmas and go to Krishna alone.
Krishna will liberate from all sins.
One should not grieve or be confused.
inference: Total refuge in Krishna removes sin and confusion.
uncertainties: Editorial glosses are fused with verse tokens.
plain_english: Abandoning all dharmas, go to me alone as refuge; I will liberate you from all sins, do not grieve.
